if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")

pacman::p_load(

  tidytext,     # unnest_tokens(), stop_words, get_sentiments(), bind_tf_idf()
  textdata,     # downloads the AFINN and NRC sentiment lexicons
  janeaustenr,  # the six Jane Austen novels
  gutenbergr,   # downloads books from Project Gutenberg
  scales,       # percent axis labels
  wordcloud,    # word clouds
  reshape2,     # acast(), needed for comparison clouds
  tm,           # corpus and term-document matrix tools
  RColorBrewer, # colour palettes
  rvest         # reads HTML files (Part 8)
)
